<!-- pr-reviewer: 7cd3229666146ec17aeb029805fa09887fc479eb -->

**Needs changes before merge.** The crate is well-formed and the default path is untouched, but the law suite ships several "holds" that cannot fail, and a few stage-level refusals are silently swallowed. Those are the two claims this PR makes.

## What looks good

- The switch is read once, in one place, with a logged diagnostic. The default is the old planner. Every phase-1 kind is refused by name under new. No call site touches the kernel yet; nothing moved. The pins hold the default.
- Checked constructors are real: private fields, named-refusal refusals, `#[non_exhaustive]` enums, `Fallback` with asked->used honesty, `postable()` only for `Done`. No unchecked index math. No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic` in production paths.
- The production guards in `kernel_emit` match the claims: lateral rapid only at/above clearance; approach below the stock top refused; cut/link/exit starting off the tool refused; a level that ends not Clear refused. Arc runs check circle membership and monotonicity.
- The geometry additions are honest: segment tests, arc points (chord tolerance, bounded), medial axis (bounded, panic-free, termination-safe), side offset. The delaunay is bounded and refuses rather than panics.
- The real stages are pinned: `l4_fallback` runs the real entry stage, `order_link.rs` and the k3/k4/k6a pins run the real K2-K4 stages, not just standins.
- The baselines genuinely exercise the old planner against golden `.cl` files; the fig8 tables honestly record the broken readings of the old planner today.
- The `xtask` lists and pins are coherent with the new crate.

## Results (local, trial-merged tree, clean merge, current main `d38fd542`)

No runner was used: the PR adds a crate (new `Cargo.toml` and edges) and touches `xtask/`, so the `pr-test.yml` workflow refuses it. The crate and edges are approved by the maintainer (record #4024 in RECOMMENDED.md); the review built locally on the trial-merged tree. Trial merge: clean, no conflicts.

- `cargo test -p camcraft-pathkernel`: lib 5 pass; laws 163 pass
- geometry new modules: 21 pass
- `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --test kernel_laws`: 31 pass
- `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --test pass_start_levels`: 45 pass, incl. the 16 recorded baselines for the phase-1 kinds
- `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --lib -- kernel`: 13 pass
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test offset_pass_start planner_switch`: 2 pass, 1 heavy-lane ignored by design
- `cargo test -p xtask`: all pass (exit 0)
- clippy `-p camcraft-pathkernel -p camcraft-geometry -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -D warnings`: clean
- clippy `-p camcraft-app --all-targets -D warnings`: clean

Targeted tests: no post or toolpath change, so no example catalog suites owed. Light lane (release, 7 steps on the merged tree): all 7 ok — light build, motion lib light twins, three adaptive-troch light twins, app pocket_pass_start light (fig8 outside + kernel baseline), app offset_pass_start light (fig8 adaptive2d/offset2d/pocket3d). Wall 20.9 min, 0 failed. Heavy lanes are not owed for a P2: the fig8 heavy pins are ignored in debug by design; the release light twins ran above.

## Requested before merge

1. Law-suite "holds" that cannot fail. One rule to close the class: every law assertion must be able to break, and a refusal must never count as held.
   - `crates/pathkernel/tests/laws/l7_move.rs:32-35` and `:58-62`: the L7 holds test compares the kernel against its own output (`run(&good(), &square_case().unwrap(), ...)`). It can never break. Make the record come from the old planner, or drop the holds test.
   - `crates/pathkernel/tests/laws/kit.rs:116-118` plus `l5_entry.rs:24-28`, `l6_load.rs:18-21`, `l3_order.rs:32-39`: a refusal is recorded as held (0.0/0.0). Any stage that always refuses passes every law. Refuse the run instead of recording held.
   - `crates/pathkernel/tests/laws/l5_entry.rs:40`: a full-fill into-material entry is accepted at 0.0 by construction. Measure the fill for IntoMaterial proofs, or refuse.
   - `crates/pathkernel/tests/laws/l6_load.rs:38-39`: the always-held report row can never fail. Drop it or relabel it a non-law tally.
   - `crates/pathkernel/tests/laws/l2_sides.rs:39-52`: a refused Inside or Outside side yields a 0.0/0.0 and skips the Inside leg entirely. Treat a refused side as a broken measure.
2. Silent recovery of rejected geometry and entries. One rule to close the class: never silently recover a refused or rejected result; refuse by name or record the fallback.
   - `crates/pathkernel/src/region_build.rs:132-134`: a mis-oriented center is silently re-canonicalized through `Region::new`. The `NOT_ORIENTED` refusal that `PlanarRegion::new` documents is unreachable. Refuse the unoriented center.
   - `crates/pathkernel/src/entry/stage.rs:178-183`: the ABOVE branch fabricates an Air entry and drops the `ABOVE` reason. `needs_fallback` is false by design for a material ask, so the why is never recorded. Either record a named fallback or drop the dead constant.
   - `crates/pathkernel/src/entry/exit.rs:54-64`: `Exit::new` admits a retract below the material top; the contract is enforced only by `Exit::proved` (line 68). Enforce it in both constructors.
   - `crates/motion/src/kernel_emit/pen.rs:140-149` and `:268-271`: a too-small retract is silently clamped to clearance. Refuse by name instead.
   - `crates/pathkernel/src/entry/exit.rs:115-136`: a lead-out that does not fit is silently dropped, with no note or fallback. Record the fallback.
   - `crates/pathkernel/src/entry/material.rs:117,128`, `crates/pathkernel/src/entry/air.rs:103,111,115`, `crates/pathkernel/src/entry/hole.rs:26,28`, `crates/pathkernel/src/entry/column.rs:37,40`, `crates/pathkernel/src/load/trochoid.rs:188`: silent `.ok()` swallows of construction failures. Record a note that names the failed check.
   - `crates/motion/src/kernel_emit/arcs.rs:58-60`: an empty arc output is reported as `ARC_NOT_MONOTONE`. Give the empty case its own reason.
3. Minor docs and process (not behaviour-changing, still worth fixing):
   - About 51 files cite `docs/decisions/4024-path-kernel-design.md`, which was deleted when RECOMMENDED.md was gathered into the release notes. Re-point the references (worst offenders: `crates/pathkernel/src/lib.rs`, `crates/app/src/operation/planner_switch.rs`, `crates/motion/tests/pass_start_levels/kernel_baseline/mod.rs`), and make the 4055 decision record point at its live location (RECOMMENDED.md, `## #4024`). The RECOMMENDED.md #4024 record also lacks the dependency-items/why-the-caller-cannot-pass-them-in/what-rebuilds facts for the two new edges.
   - `crates/motion/tests/kernel_laws.rs` is a new top-level test binary. It is neither in ISOLATED (`xtask/src/lanes.rs`) nor SLOW_BINARIES (`xtask/src/plan.rs`). Add the one-line reason in the PR body.
4. Merge conditions not met. The body asks for the batch gate, the heavy `motion` and `app` steps and the `example_catalog*` suites on this merged head, with results posted in a PR comment. No such comment exists today. Do not merge before they are green and posted.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)

- `WRITE_GOLDEN=1` can silently rebake goldens. A length/content pin would help.
- The switch is process-wide and cached in a `OnceLock`; a later re-read sees the first value. Document this.
- `crates/geometry/src/geo2d/medial.rs:101-102` divides by the denominator before the finite check. No panic today, but check first.
- The fig8 2D Pocket readings test is not `#[ignore]`d and has no light twin.
- `notes.rs` fallback classifiers are word-list driven; fail-loud, but dependent on the note text.
- `guide/cover.rs:81-84`, `region_build.rs:37-39`, `entry/room.rs`: `geo()` discards the underlying error kind; every geometry failure becomes a generic refusal. Carry the kind into the refusal.
- `l1_guide.rs:34-35`: L1 refusals match on reason alone; the standins share one reason. Distinguish reasons or document the limit.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

**Needs changes before merge.** The class A fix (#4406) landed and looks honest; the class B findings are not landed, the PR conflicts with main, and the merge conditions from the body are not met for this head. Not built: the PR adds an internal crate (Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock) and touches xtask/, which is refused by the pr-test workflow and must not be built in this review.

## What looks good

- The class A fix (test-only, #4406) is real work, not a relabel. `kit.rs` gives `LawVerdict` an `Outcome` (Held / Broken / Refused), so a refused or unread leg is never held; a law with no measures is refused; `measure` legs carry a refusal reason. `refusals.rs` runs every law on always-refusing stand-ins. `registry.rs` fails a kind that refuses an unregistered reason. L2 no longer skips the order leg; L5 reads an IntoMaterial descent (moves in the plane or is an asked plunge) and breaks a hidden plunge named a helix; L6 drops the always-held report row; L7 reads the record from a recorded file (`records/square_pocket.txt`), not from the run under test.
- `registry.rs` and the new `kit_geo.rs` read as genuine fixes for the "holds that cannot fail" class.
- The class A decision record (`docs/decisions/4406-law-suite-refusal-never-held.md`) states the rule of the class and the per-check changes.
- The switch is still read once, in one place, with a logged diagnostic; the default is the old planner; the pins hold that; nothing moved to the kernel yet.
- `xtask` lists and pins are coherent with the new crate so far.

## Results

Not built (see the bottom of this review). Trial merge on `origin/main` (this worktree): **conflicts**. Files:
- `Cargo.toml` - workspace members and workspace dependencies: the PR adds `crates/pathkernel`, main adds `crates/ui-kit` (#4394). Both sides must be kept.
- `xtask/src/plan.rs` - BATCH_CRATES / ALL_CRATES / CLIPPY: the PR adds `pathkernel`, main adds `ui-kit`. Both sides must be kept.
- `xtask/src/heavy_plan_tests.rs` - geometry reach list and the all-but-gpu filter: both sides must be kept.
- `xtask/src/step_tests.rs` - the crate list in the prebuild test: both sides must be kept.

No build, no test, no clippy, no gate was run for this head. Do not merge until the conflicts are resolved and a fresh review is clean.

Also not met for this head (only on the old head `7cd322966`, in the 18:12 comment): the batch gate, the heavy `motion` and `app` steps, the `example_catalog*` suites - the results are not posted for `21fd9e57d`. The class B sub-PR (#4407) is open.

## Targeted tests (step 5)

Not run (no build). The example catalog suites are not owed: this PR changes no post or toolpath output (the default planner is unchanged). The light lane is not run. No `P1` or wrong-output work is here, so no targeted heavy step.

## Requested before merge

1. Conflicts with main (4 files, listed above). Merge `origin/main` into the branch and keep both sides on each clash (workspace members, xtask lists, the reach test filters). Push the merge and re-request a fresh review.
2. Class B: silent recovery of rejected geometry and entries (#4407, open). One rule: never silently recover a refused or rejected result; refuse by name or record the fallback. Still present at this head:
   - `crates/pathkernel/src/region_build.rs:132` - a mis-oriented center is silently re-canonicalized through `Region::new`; the `NOT_ORIENTED` refusal is unreachable. Refuse the unoriented center.
   - `crates/pathkernel/src/entry/stage.rs:178-183` - the above-top branch fabricates an Air entry and drops the `ABOVE` reason; `needs_fallback` is false by design for a material ask. Record a named fallback or drop the dead constant.
   - `crates/pathkernel/src/entry/exit.rs:54-64` - `Exit::new` admits a retract below the material top; the contract is enforced only by `Exit::proved`. Enforce it in both constructors.
   - `crates/motion/src/kernel_emit/pen.rs:140-149` and `268-271` - a too-small retract is silently clamped to clearance (`z.max(self.h.clearance_z())`). Refuse by name instead.
   - `crates/pathkernel/src/entry/exit.rs:115-136` - a lead-out that does not fit is silently dropped (`Exit::proved(last, None, ...)`), with no note or fallback. Record the fallback.
   - `crates/pathkernel/src/entry/material.rs:79,117,128`, `air.rs:103,111,115`, `hole.rs:26,28`, `column.rs:37,40`, `load/trochoid.rs:188` - silent `.ok()` swallows of construction failures. Record a note that names the failed check.
   - `crates/motion/src/kernel_emit/arcs.rs:58-60` - an empty arc output is reported as `ARC_NOT_MONOTONE`. Give the empty case its own reason.
3. Merge conditions for `21fd9e57d`: run the batch gate, the heavy `motion` and `app` steps, and the `example_catalog*` suites on the merged tree, and post the results in a comment on the PR. The 18:12 comment's results are for the old head and do not count.
4. Not built: the maintainer must look at `Cargo.toml`, `Cargo.lock`, `crates/pathkernel/Cargo.toml`, `crates/motion/Cargo.toml`, `xtask/src/*.rs` before this PR is merged. This review does not build it. If the maintainer wants a full build, a green local build of the trial-merged tree is owed.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)

- About 48 files cite `docs/decisions/4024-path-kernel-design.md`, which was deleted when RECOMMENDED.md was gathered into the release notes. Re-point them at RECOMMENDED.md `## #4024` (the 4055 record points at its live location), and add the dependency-items/why/rebuilds facts for the two new edges.
- `WRITE_GOLDEN=1` can silently rebake goldens. A length/content pin helps.
- The switch is process-wide and cached in a `OnceLock`; a later re-read sees the first value. Document this.
- `crates/geometry/src/geo2d/medial.rs:101-102` divides by the denominator before the finite check. No panic today, but check first.
- The fig8 2D Pocket readings test is not `#[ignore]`d and has no light twin.
- `notes.rs` fallback classifiers are word-list driven; fail-loud, but dependent on the note text.
- `guide/cover.rs:81-84`, `region_build.rs:37-39`, `entry/room.rs`: `geo()` discards the underlying error kind; every geometry failure becomes a generic refusal. Carry the kind into the refusal.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
